Join the Solubrae Circle: Affiliate Partner Program

About Solubrae

Solubrae was born from a simple desire: to keep the elegance, the connection, and the ritual of a shared glass of wine... without the alcohol. Founded by Patricia Heaton and David Hunt, our wines are crafted for the "Social but Sober" set. We believe that choosing not to drink shouldn't mean settling for sugary juices or missing out on the toast. Solubrae is real wine, reimagined for a brighter, clearer tomorrow.

What Makes Us Different

We don’t make "grape juice." We make alcohol-removed wine.

  • The Process: We start with premium California-grown grapes (like our flagship Pinot Grigio "Daylight"). After traditional fermentation, we use a gentle "spinning cone" process to remove the alcohol while preserving the delicate aromatics, structure, and acidity.

  • The Experience: With 0.0% to <0.5% ABV, Solubrae offers the sophisticated mouthfeel and "tasting notes" of a high-end vintage.

  • The Mission: We sit at the intersection of wellness and hospitality. Whether it’s our crisp Daylight white or our vibrant Sundown rosé, Solubrae is designed to be served in a stemmed glass and paired with a great meal.

Partner Benefits: How You Earn

We value the authority and creativity you bring to your community. Our program is designed to reward high-quality advocacy:

  • Competitive Commissions: Earn [15%] on every sale generated through your unique link or code.

  • Performance Tiers: Top-performing partners (including Sommeliers and Wine Educators) are eligible for higher commission rates and exclusive bonuses.

  • Exclusive Discounts: A custom discount code for your followers to help drive conversions.

  • Early Access: Be the first to taste new varietals and seasonal releases before they hit the public shop.

How to Promote Solubrae

We encourage our partners to showcase Solubrae as a lifestyle choice, not just a product.

  • The Ritual: Share your "5:00 PM transition" or your favorite dinner party pairings.

  • Educational Content: For our wine pros, dive into the "Spinning Cone" tech, the authenticity of our California grapes, and the tasting notes (citrus, sea breeze, wild strawberry).

  • Wellness Integration: Highlight the "No-Hangover" benefit — waking up fog-free and ready for a morning workout or a productive day.

  • Gifting & Hosting: Position our 4, 6, and 12-bottle bundles as the perfect host gift for inclusive entertaining.

Other Information

  • Cookie Window: We offer a 30-day cookie life, giving you credit for any return shoppers.

  • Professional Assets: Access to high-res bottle shots, lifestyle imagery, and brand talking points.

  • Support: Our team is here to help with custom campaign ideas or product samples for approved creators.
